caption:
Boat tour from Funchal, Madeira: a dolphin in mid-air, and the cliff is just the backdrop.

The dolphin fills most of the picture. It is grey and smooth, with a pale belly, a curved fin on its back and a small dark eye. The whole body is clear of the water, and drops are still flying off it.

Behind it, a tall brown cliff, blurry and a little out of focus. A cliff that size is usually the main character out here. In this picture it has been moved to the background.

Below, deep blue water with a few small white crests. Above, clear blue sky.

We cannot promise a visit like this. Wildlife does what it wants, and we would not have it any other way. What we can promise is the coast: our Day Trip leaves Funchal marina at 10:00 or 14:00 and passes Câmara de Lobos and Cabo Girão, with a swim and paddle stop at Fajã dos Padres. The Sunset Trip follows the same coast, without swimming. Both are private, with a skipper, five guests at most, and food on board.

O mar também tem pressa.

Would you keep your eyes on the water, or on the cliffs? Book direct on chifbay.com
